items.title: Agents can now find Vercel CLI commands by describing the task
items.summary: Coding agents can now use  to find Vercel CLI commands by describing a task in plain language.vercel help searchThe search returns a list of matching commands. Add  to include the help page for the first result in the same call. For example,  returns the options and examples for .--with-helpvercel help search "roll back production" --with-helpvercel rollbackSearch also supports:Search recognizes common wording, such as “show” instead of “list,” and handles minor spelling mistakes.The CLI also includes a skill that tells coding agents to start with  when looking for a command. Vercel doesn't log your search text.vercel help searchUpdate to the latest Vercel CLI with .vercel upgradeRead more When a Vercel API endpoint matches the task, search returns a  command with the request path and placeholders for every required input. The agent can fill in the values without guessing the path.API endpoints:vercel api Use  to return search results as JSON. Combine it with  to include usage instructions, options, and examples for the first result.JSON output:--json--with-help
